title: THE FASHION RACKS LINE UP
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08, on the 4K FASHION picture. In the OUTFIT rack a name too long for one line (The Skeleton, The Tomb Explorer, The Street Poet) pushed its OWNED or WORN word a whole line lower than the tiles beside it, so the row looked ragged. The status word now sits at the foot of every tile, so a row lines up whatever the names, and the names stay right under their pictures.
now: In Fashion, the OWNED and WORN words now line up across each rack, even under a two line name.
